benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Settled down 6 cents on 2 Oct as G7 nations agreed to release diesel and crude reserves (100 mb over four months, front-loaded diesel in the first 20 days) to ease the fuel squeeze. Week-ago uses 23 Sep (9 days prior, Wikipedia chronology) — the closest dated figure found this run, not a full week.

source.name: The Daily Star (AFP) — Oil settles lower after Europe agrees to tap diesel reserves

benchmarks.label: WTI

peak.note: EIA Cushing spot high via FRED.

benchmarks.note: Fell $1.76 (-1.9%) on 2 Oct as the G7's diesel/crude reserve release plan pointed to refined-product constraints easing rather than crude scarcity, with Middle East flows continuing to recover. Week-ago uses 23 Sep (9 days prior, Wikipedia chronology) — the closest dated figure found this run, not a full week.

source.name: The Daily Star (AFP) — Oil settles lower after Europe agrees to tap diesel reserves

benchmarks.label: TTF gas
benchmarks.note: Staged a sharp afternoon recovery on 2 Oct, reversing earlier losses to trade near €75.80 intraday before settling at €74.76 (+1.1%). Week-ago reuses the prior run's figure (1 day earlier, not a full week) — the closest dated figure available. Pre-crisis €32.00 is derived from RTÉ's figure of +€14.52 to €46.52 on 2 March.

benchmarks.label: Henry Hub
benchmarks.note: Value is the NYMEX front-month on 2 Oct (Trading Economics), up 2.3% d/d; week-ago reuses the prior run's figure (1 day earlier, not a full week); pre-crisis is the EIA spot price on 27 Feb (FRED). US LNG feedgas and exports are near records, but the US price is largely insulated.

note: Brent and WTI settled lower on 2 October after G7 governments agreed to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude reserves over four months, front-loaded in the first 20 days, to ease Europe's fuel squeeze; the strait remains formally closed. TTF and Henry Hub ticked up on the day.
